    Catalog

    The catalog lists every ready-made system by field and again by topic. Each subfield gives the statement that imports its classes, and each system its class, its model parameters, and its capability tags. The page of a system gives the defaults of its parameters and all its tags. all_systems of skcomplex.systems lists the classes of a field, a topic, or a tag, as in the block below, which names the stochastic systems of ecology. The search box of the site finds a system by its name, description, or topic.

    from skcomplex.systems import all_systems

names = [name for name, _ in all_systems(field='biology/ecology', tags={'randomness': 'stochastic'})]

    By field

    biology/collective_behaviour

    from skcomplex.systems.biology.collective_behaviour import <Class>

    System Class Parameters Time Space Laws Randomness
    Active walkers and trail formation ActiveWalkersSystem size, n_walkers, attraction, T, random_state continuous, discrete lattice rate, update stochastic
    Ant colony optimization on a road network AntColonyOptimizationSystem n_points, ants, steps, alpha, beta, rho, Q, cut, seed discrete none update stochastic
    Binary ant decision BinaryAntDecisionSystem flux, k, h, evaporation, stochastic continuous none jump stochastic
    Bird swarm with pair potentials BirdSwarmSystem n_birds, alpha, beta, C_a, l_a, C_r, l_r, random_state continuous continuous rate deterministic
    Boids in three dimensions Boids3dSystem n_boids, size, radius, cohesion, separation, alignment, random_state discrete continuous update stochastic

    By topic

    Achlioptas process

    • Explosive percolation by the Achlioptas product rule ExplosivePercolationSystem: Explosive percolation.

    B-tipping

    • Stochastic energy balance with bifurcation-, noise-, and rate-induced tipping SuteraFraedrichTippingSystem: The Sutera-Fraedrich stochastic energy balance set up for tipping.

    Belousov-Zhabotinsky

    • Oregonator OregonatorSystem: The scaled Oregonator of the Belousov-Zhabotinsky reaction.

    COMETS

    • COMETS: dynamic flux balance on a lattice with diffusion CometsSystem: An expanding colony of the E. coli core system on a lattice.

    ENSO

    • ENSO delay oscillator ENSOSystem: The delayed oscillator of El Niño of Suarez and Schopf.

    Edgeworth box

    • Edgeworth and Red Cross barter BarterSystem: Barter of chocolate and cigarettes.

    El Niño

    • ENSO delay oscillator ENSOSystem: The delayed oscillator of El Niño of Suarez and Schopf.

    Gaia

    • Daisyworld DaisyworldSystem: Daisyworld.

    Garden of Eden

    • Life in a tree LifeInATreeSystem: The Game of Life on the free group F4, surjective but not pre-injective.
    • Muller's pre-injective non-surjective automaton on F2 MullerAutomatonSystem: Muller's automaton on the free group F2, pre-injective but not surjective.
    • Surjective non-pre-injective linear automaton on F2 SurjectiveLinearAutomatonSystem: A linear automaton over K^2 on the free group F2.

    Gompertz

    • Norton-Simon Gompertzian cell kill NortonSimonSystem: The Norton-Simon system of a Gompertzian tumour under a dose schedule.
    • Tumour and vascular volume under an angiogenesis inhibitor HahnfeldtSystem: The Hahnfeldt system, a tumour whose carrying capacity is its vasculature.

    HER2

    • Paclitaxel and trastuzumab with antibody binding HER2TargetedTherapySystem: HER2+ breast cancer cells under trastuzumab and paclitaxel.

    Hill function

    • Goodwin oscillator GoodwinOscillatorSystem: The Goodwin oscillator, a chain of stages.

    • Effector cells, tumour, and IL-2 under adoptive therapy KirschnerPanettaSystem: The Kirschner-Panetta system of effector cells, tumour cells, and IL-2.
    • Optimal adoptive therapy and IL-2 dosing OptimalImmunotherapySystem: A tumour under the adoptive therapy and IL-2 injection that minimise it.

    Koopman operator

    • Quadratic system with a slow manifold and a finite Koopman embedding KoopmanSlowManifoldSystem: The quadratic flow x1' = mu x1, x2' = lam (x2 - x1^2).

    • Koch KochCurveSystem: The Koch curve as the L-system F → F+F--F+F drawn by a turtle.

    • Bistability on a catalyst pellet CatalystPelletSystem: The surface concentration of a catalyst pellet.
